title: Eval shard dispatch
description: repository_dispatch client_payload for one evaluation shard. It carries opaque IDs, the manifest reference and the runner labels the shard must run on, never cases, prompts, model keys or cloud credentials. Version 1.1 keeps only the 8 fields needed before the workflow starts; manifest digest, expiry and scripts bundle pin come from the shard descriptor endpoint and are merged into the runner-facing dispatch file. Version 1.0 dispatches remain valid for compatibility. GitHub allows at most 10 top-level properties and 64KB per dispatch.

job_timeout_minutes.description: GitHub execute job timeout derived from the frozen case budget. Optional for dispatches created before #304; the workflow falls back to 60 minutes only when absent.
